# Unicode 17.0.0
# What normalization reads of every code point, from UnicodeData.txt and
# DerivedNormalizationProps.txt of the Unicode Character Database:
# `first[..last];class;decomposition;quick`. The class is the Canonical_Combining_Class, left
# out where it is 0. The decomposition is one step of the Decomposition_Mapping, after `~` where
# it is a compatibility mapping. The quick checks are C where NFC_Quick_Check is No and c where
# it is Maybe, and K and k for NFKC_Quick_Check. A code point in no line has class 0, no
# decomposition and Yes for both; a Hangul syllable is in none, its decomposition being arithmetic.
# © 2025 Unicode®, Inc. Distributed under the Unicode License v3, in LICENSE beside this file.
